scripts.dev: sh -c 'kill $(lsof -t -i:5000 -i:3000) 2>/dev/null; sleep 0.5; python3 tts_server.py & TTS_PID=$!; cleanup() { kill $TTS_PID 2>/dev/null; }; trap cleanup INT TERM EXIT; bun --hot ./index.ts'
scripts.start: sh -c 'kill $(lsof -t -i:5000 -i:3000) 2>/dev/null; sleep 0.5; python3 tts_server.py & TTS_PID=$!; cleanup() { kill $TTS_PID 2>/dev/null; }; trap cleanup INT TERM EXIT; bun ./index.ts'
